({{langx|ca-valencia|Elx Club de Futbol, S.A.D.}}) is a Spanish professional [[association football club|football]] club based in [[Elche]], [[Province of Alicante]], in the [[Valencian Community]], Spain. Founded in 1923, the club competes in [[La Liga]], holding home matches at the [[Estadio Martínez Valero]], with a capacity of 33,732 seats.{{cite web |url=http://www.elchecf.es/club/estadio-martinez-valero |title=ESTADIO MARTÍNEZ VALERO {{!}} Elche |website=www.elchecf.es |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151222234615/http://www.elchecf.es/club/estadio-martinez-valero |archive-date=2015-12-22}} Founded in 1923 as the result of a merger between all of the town's clubs, Elche entered the league system in 1929, reaching [[Segunda División]] in [[1934–35 Segunda División|1934]] and [[La Liga]] in [[1958–59 Segunda División|1959]], finishing fifth in the latter tournament in [[1963–64 La Liga|1963–64]]. The club were runners-up in the [[Copa del Rey]] in [[1969 Copa del Generalísimo|1969]]."}}
